R181.note: crypto.randomBytes(16) replaces Math.random(); no other behavior change.

R182.note: Removing mark_safe() closes XSS but also causes Django to escape the entire returned string including the intended `<div class='announcement'>` wrapper tags, so the banner no longer renders as HTML for any user; write-up incorrectly implies only the user text gets escaped. Not disclosed.

R183.note: Adds `if (!connection) return;` guard matching contract exactly.

R184.note: Statement replaced with PreparedStatement + bound parameter, textbook fix, no other change.

R186.note: Layered rejection of scheme/absolute-path/null-byte/'..' plus realpath containment check for both existing and non-existent files; chdir() removed cleanly, legitimate access preserved.
